data.body: **P1 — Recheck fatal cleanup after invocation-end hooks.** After a handoff timeout, the handler owner can set `scopeFatal` while this awaited hook is flushing. Because the only check is before the call, `execute()` still returns PENDING/RETRYING even though a `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` was observed before finalization finished. Check `scopeFatal` again after `onInvocationEnd` and before returning, and add a delayed-finalizer test that releases fatal scope cleanup while this call is blocked.
